summary: Mobile Expo preview loaded and core dashboard, navigation, goals, EQOAI quick prompt, device UI, and backend API checks were exercised.

integration_issues.issue: Microphone control only toggles permission-ready/listening copy; no voice transport or spoken response is connected, as documented.

action_items: Connect native BLE scanning/notifications and replace placeholder UUIDs when firmware UUIDs are available.
Provide a valid direct OpenAI Realtime credential and implement voice audio transport/TTS if voice is required.
Add testID props to navigation tabs, prompts, composer, microphone, send, and device reconnect controls for robust automated regression testing.
critical_code_review_comments: Frontend reads EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL rather than the requested EXPO_BACKEND_URL; it works with the current env but is a configuration-contract risk.
API fetches have no catch/error UI; telemetry or insights failures leave the loading screen indefinitely, and chat failures can reject without user feedback.
All interactive controls lack testID attributes, making required mobile regression selectors brittle.
Settings rows and the dashboard View all label are display-only despite appearing actionable.
seed_data_creation: None; demo telemetry/profile data is application-provided.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Preview URL tested at 390x844. Dashboard and all five tabs rendered; quick prompt produced assistant response. BLE hardware and voice transport are MOCKED/documented limitations. One second script stopped on an invalid icon-text selector before device/voice actions; this is a test limitation, not confirmed app failure.
rca_of_issue: No runtime defects were reproduced. The custom-composer script reached the filled input but attempted to locate the MaterialCommunityIcons glyph by text ('arrow-up'), which is not a DOM text node; use the button testID/role after testIDs are added.
